en: Draws {#a} from the deposit to raise {#b}: the rest is spoiled in the ground. Poorer ore delivers less of what is raised
zh: 从矿藏中耗用 {a} 以采出 {b}：其余在地下糟蹋。矿石品位越低，采出物中可交付的越少

en: Draws {#a} from the deposit, all of it raised. Poorer ore delivers less of what is raised

en: {#a} jump engineers ({#b} needed), {#c} orbital crew ({#d} needed)
zh: 跃迁工程师 {a} 人（需要 {b}），轨道乘员 {c} 人（需要 {d}）
已下令施工：至少 {n} 个月。

en: Construction ordered: at least {#n} months. As the first of its kind it takes half as much work and time again.
zh: 已下令施工：至少 {n} 个月。作为同类中的第一座，工作量和工期都要多出一半。

en: Construction ordered: at least {#n} months; site power comes from the region's shaft supply, then from site engines burning coal, then refined fuel.
